newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's peso edges slightly higher to 1,062.40.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's peso edges slightly higher to 1,062.40.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 9 Reuter - Colombia's peso edged up a razor- thin 0.6 centavo to close at 1,062.40 in fairly active trade on the interbank market, dealers said.
The peso's slight rise came on a wave of dollar-selling by the corporate sector late in the session, dealers said.

"The market was more active than in the last few days, but we're still not back up to normal trading volumes," said one trader, noting that the foreign exchange market has been extremely sluggish since the Easter holidays.
Dealers reported 399 trades in Wednesday's session for a total of $161 million and said the peso traded in a 1,061.60 to 1,063.90 range.
